ruleDefinitions.name: Shell Open Registry Keys Manipulation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the shell open key manipulation (exefile and ms-settings) used for persistence and the pattern of UAC Bypass using fodhelper.exe, computerdefaults.exe, slui.exe via registry keys (e.g. UACMe 33 or 62) Note: Unmapped fields: EventType, Details

sequences.query: (EventType = "SetValue" AND registry_path = RGX("Classes\\\\ms\\-settings\\\\shell\\\\open\\\\command\\\\SymbolicLinkValue$") AND Details = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Classes\\\\\\{.*")) OR registry_path = RGX("Classes\\\\ms\\-settings\\\\shell\\\\open\\\\command\\\\DelegateExecute$") OR ((EventType = "SetValue" AND (registry_path = RGX("Classes\\\\ms\\-settings\\\\shell\\\\open\\\\command\\\\\\(Default\\)$") OR registry_path = RGX("Classes\\\\exefile\\\\shell\\\\open\\\\command\\\\\\(Default\\)$"))) AND  NOT (Details = "\(Empty\)"))
